name: oracle-sql-tidy
description: Formatter for Oracle SQL and PL/SQL: keyword case, indentation, leading or trailing commas, soft line width. Never drops or reorders a token: comments, strings, q'[...]' quotes and / terminators are kept as written.

editor/context.when: editorLangId == sql || editorLangId == plsql || editorLangId == oraclesql || editorLangId == oracle-sql

oracleSqlTidy.keywordCase.description: Case of SQL and PL/SQL keywords and built-in functions. Identifiers, strings and quoted names are never changed.

oracleSqlTidy.indentSize.description: Spaces per indentation level. 0 uses the editor's tab size and tabs/spaces setting.

oracleSqlTidy.commaStyle.description: Where commas go when a select list, SET list or parameter list is split over lines.

oracleSqlTidy.maxLineWidth.description: Soft line width: longer lines are wrapped between tokens (never inside strings or comments). 0 turns wrapping off.
